results.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - R01556437
results.jd_text:
Senior Software Development Engineer \n 
 
 
 Primary Skills 
 AngularJS, JavaScript, CSS3, React JS, Java, Hibernate, Oracle RDBMS, Docker, Spring Core, Spring Boot, HTML5, MySQL 
 
 Job requirements 
 Overview We are seeking a skilled QA Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain automated test suites across frontend, backend, and integration layers. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with modern test automation frameworks and tools, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and reliable digital solutions. Key Skills & Expertise Must Have Skills Automation Frameworks – Strong experience with Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright. Frontend Automation – Hands-on testing React.js applications (React TestingLibrary, Jest). Backend/API Automation – Proficient in API testing with Postman, PyTest, or REST-assured (REST/GraphQL validation). Programming/Scripting – Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for building test scripts. Database Testing – SQL skills for backend validation and data integrity checks. CI/CD Integration – Embedding automated tests in pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). Version Control – Proficient with Git workflows (branching, merging, PRs). Agile Collaboration – Experience working in Agile/Scrum, with Jira or similar tools. Nice to Have Skills • Containerization/Cloud Awareness – Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure. • AI/ML Testing – Exposure to validating AI-driven components (e.g., test script generation). 
 
 
 \n

results.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - R01566591
results.jd_text:
Senior Software Development Engineer \n 
 
 
 Primary Skills 
 
 DB2 
 
 
 Job requirements 
 
 AS400 Developer Experience: 3–5 years Department: Digital Engineering Employment Type: Full-time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced AS400 (IBM i) Developer to design, develop, and maintain business-critical applications on the IBM iSeries platform. The ideal candidate has strong RPG programming skills, a solid understanding of DB2 for i, and experience supporting and modernizing legacy enterprise systems. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain applications on the IBM i (AS400/iSeries) platform using RPG (RPG IV / RPGLE / Free-format RPG), CL, and SQL. Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications and robust solutions. Develop and optimize DB2 for i database objects — physical/logical files, tables, views, and stored procedures. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal downtime for business-critical systems. Perform code reviews, unit testing, and support system integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Maintain and enhance existing legacy applications while supporting modernization initiatives (e.g., migration to free-format RPG, web enablement, API integration). Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, QA, and infrastructure teams. Create and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions. Adhere to coding standards, change management processes, and SDLC best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in AS400/IBM i application development. Strong proficiency in RPG IV, RPGLE, and Free-format RPG. Solid experience with CL (Control Language) programming. Strong knowledge of DB2 for i and embedded SQL / SQLRPGLE. Experience with development tools such as RDi (Rational Developer for i), PDM, SEU, and DDS. Good understanding of file structures (physical and logical files), data areas, and data queues. Experience in debugging, performance tuning, and production support. Familiarity with version control and change management tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Warehouse Management Systems, Food Sales/Service Apps Experience with modernization tools (e.g., web services / REST APIs on IBM i, Profound UI, or similar). Knowledge of integration technologies (MQ, EDI, or middleware). Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. IBM i certifications. Soft Skills Ability to work independently and within a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Effective collaboration and stakeholder communication. 
 
 
 
 \n

results.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - R01569774
results.jd_text:
Senior Software Development Engineer \n 
 
 
 Primary Skills 
 
 Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Storage Queues, Azure Logic Apps, Azure AKS, Azure Content Delivery Network, Azure App Service, Azure Functions 
 
 
 Job requirements 
 Experience Range: 
 
   
 
 With at least 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Azure development and cloud-native engineering 
 
   
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
 1. Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications and scalable backend services supporting healthcare member journeys 
 
 2. Build and optimize APIs and microservices on Azure cloud platforms, ensuring high performance and security 
 
 3. Integrate conversational AI interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, and AI-powered user experiences 
 
 4. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection controls across APIs and application services 
 
 5. Integrate enterprise healthcare APIs and data sources to enable provider search, benefits guidance, and cost estimation workflows 
 
 6. Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or OpenShift, supporting CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation  
 
 7. Enhance observability, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization for cloud-native applications 
 
 8. Write clean, testable, and production-ready code, participate in code reviews, and implement automated testing and quality engineering practices 
 
   
 
 Required Skills: 
 
 1. Next.js 
 
 2. Node.js 
 
 3. Azure Service Bus 
 
 4. Azure API Management 
 
 5. Azure Storage Queues 
 
 6. Azure Logic Apps 7. Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) 
 
 8. Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) 
 
 9. Azure App Service 
 
 10. Azure Functions 
 
   
 
 Preferred Skills: 
 
 1. Experience with conversational AI frameworks 
 
 2. Expertise in prompt engineering 
 
 3. Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and secure coding practices in healthcare  
 
 4. Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI Gateway integration 
 
 5. Familiarity with enterprise healthcare API standards 
 
 6. Experience with semantic search technologies  
 
 7. Avaya Contact Center integration 
 
 8. Advanced proficiency in CI/CD pipeline automation and monitoring tools 
 
   
 
  Desired Qualifications: 
 
 1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline 
 
 2. Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or equivalent Azure certification 
 
 3. Certification in AI engineering or cloud-native development (such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate) is highly desirable 
 
 
 \n

results.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - R01569776
results.jd_text:
Senior Software Development Engineer \n 
 
 
 Primary Skills 
 
 Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Storage Queues, Azure Logic Apps, Azure AKS, Azure Content Delivery Network, Azure App Service, Azure Functions 
 
 
 Job requirements 
 Experience Range: 
 
 
 With at least 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in AI-powered healthcare solution development and Azure cloud engineering 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities:  
 
 
 Design and develop AI-powered healthcare solutions leveraging large language models and Generative AI services to enhance member experiences  
 
 Build and enhance conversational healthcare assistants, implementing intelligent workflows for personalized member service journeys  
 
 Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including semantic search, healthcare knowledge retrieval, and integration with vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources  
 
 Engineer and orchestrate AI agents for complex healthcare workflows, implementing multi-step reasoning, tool-calling patterns, and workflow automation  
 
 Enable healthcare member experience features such as provider search, facility search, symptom guidance, benefits and coverage guidance, cost estimation, claims status, and contact center escalation  
 
 Collaborate with AI architects and platform teams to implement AI Gateway integrations, LLM routing and orchestration, prompt management, transcript logging, observability, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks  
 
 Develop and optimize APIs, backend services, and chatbot interfaces, integrating AI models into web-based applications while ensuring performance, latency, and cost efficiency  
 
 Ensure AI solutions adhere to healthcare privacy requirements, implementing guardrails, monitoring, safety mechanisms, and supporting HIPAA and Responsible AI compliance  
 
 
 Required Skills: 
 
 
 Node.js  
 
 TypeScript  
 
 Next.js  
 
 Microsoft Azure  
 
 Azure AI Services  
 
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)  
 
 Vector database integration  
 
 Semantic search  
 
 API development  
 
 LLM orchestration  
 
 
 Preferred Skills:  
 
 
 Knowledge graph engineering  
 
 Healthcare ontology modeling  
 
 Azure Service Bus  
 
 Azure API Management  
 
 Azure Storage Queues  
 
 Azure Logic Apps  
 
 Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) 
 
 Azure Content Delivery Network  
 
 Azure App Service  
 
 Azure Functions  
 
 Advanced prompt engineering  
 
 AI evaluation frameworks  
 
 Observability tools  
 
 Workflow automation with agentic architectures  
 
 
 Desired Qualifications: 
 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline 
 
 Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate  
 
 Certification in Responsible AI or HIPAA healthcare data privacy 
 
 
 
 \n
